player_prompt.intro: O n ṣere 2048 lori igbimọ {board_size}x{board_size}. Idi rẹ ni lati de ọdọ tile {target_tile} nipa fifọ awọn nọmba kanna papọ! Awọn gbigbe to wulo: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Awọn tile darapọ nigbati wọn ba kọlu, ilọpo meji iye wọn.

invalid_move.no_change: Board did not change - choose a different direction.

outcome.win: Mo kí yín, ẹ ti dé {target_tile}! Ìṣirò ìkẹyìn {score}.
outcome.lose: Kò sí ìgbésẹ̀ kankan tí ó kù. Àkọsílẹ̀ tí ó pọ̀ jù {max_tile} - ìparí ìpele {score}.
